title: pack.toml
description: A brainrc pack's manifest, after it is parsed as TOML (docs/packs.md#packtoml). validate warns on a key not listed here.

name.description: The pack's name; default: its packs.toml table or folder name.

prefix.description: What every skill, agent, command and MCP server name starts with; default: "<name>-" (docs/packs.md#naming).

id.description: The <owner>/<pack> ID the pack is published under (docs/packs.md#naming).

description.description: One line on what the pack is for.

requires_api.description: Pack API versions the pack works with, e.g. "^1"; core content releases never break it (docs/packs.md#compatibility).

requires_core.description: Deprecated: pin requires_api instead. Core versions the pack works with, e.g. ">=0.8, <0.9"; ignored when requires_api is set (docs/packs.md#compatibility).

max_always_tokens.description: Budget for the tokens the pack loads into every session: rules plus descriptions (docs/packs.md#context-cost).

validator.description: A Python module in the pack that checks what only it understands (docs/packs.md#validator-plugins).

test.description: The pack's own unittest tests, a directory or a .py file in the pack; validate --pack runs them (docs/packs.md#pack-tests).

scope.description: Where the pack applies: any glob matching means it does; none means everywhere (docs/packs.md#scope).

guard.description: [[guard.deny]] and [[guard.ask]] rules core's guard hook enforces, with match or tool, reason and scope; deny rules may name a path or host for the OS sandbox instead (docs/packs.md#guard-rules).

extensions.description: Tables other packs read, one per namespace, e.g. [extensions.gatework]; the pack that owns a namespace checks it (docs/packs.md#extensions).

remotes.description: Globs for a git remote of the repo you're in, as host/owner/repo (github.com/acme/*) or the URL as written.

paths.description: Globs for the directory you're in or one above it; ~ and $VARS expand.

tickets.description: Globs for a ticket ref in the branch name (ACME-*), or one passed to `brainrc scope --ticket`.

match.description: A command: its program, then these words in order, as a shell splits them; each word may be a glob.

tool.description: An MCP tool name, as a glob: mcp__<server>__<tool>.

path.description: A file or directory (~/... or /...) the OS sandbox refuses to read or write; [[guard.deny]] only, with scope = {} in a scoped pack.

host.description: A domain (*.example.com allowed) the OS sandbox refuses network access to; [[guard.deny]] only, with scope = {} in a scoped pack.

reason.description: What the command does, shown when the guard stops it.

scope.description: Where this rule applies, in place of the pack's [scope].

deny.description: Commands and MCP tools the guard refuses, and paths and hosts the OS sandbox refuses.

ask.description: Commands and MCP tools the guard asks about first.
